definitions.short: properly, cut out (or hollow ), i.e. (by implication) a pocket
definitions.full: H2754. charit [ חָרִיט ] noun masculine 1Ki 5:23 bag, purse (compare Arabic bag or purse made of skin or other material) — only plural absolute חֲרִטִים שְׁנֵי 2Kin 5:23 , containing each a talent of silver; הָֽחֲרִיטִים Isa 3:22 in list of ladies' finery.
definitions.rootNote: or חָרִט ; from the same as 2747 ;
